Non-TTY install fails with AGENT_SELECTION_REQUIRED, while repeatable -a/--agent and --all isolated-home tests select exact agent sets; lifecycle coverage exercises --yes.
Isolated-home reconciliation tests cover exact selected writes, deselected managed removal, convergence, unmanaged collisions, directories, symlink ancestors, and root-boundary validation.
Lifecycle tests confirm npm update runs before empirical install --yes and that package and integration stage failures remain distinct.
Generated-skill integration tests and source audit confirm MCP tool names remain primary and every CLI fallback uses the private __internal namespace.

README and documentation audit found only Install and Update as normal user terminal commands and documents selector controls, automation flags, agent invocations, MCP workflow ownership, and update behavior.
